newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-KEANE SET TO RETURN FOR MANCHESTER UNITED.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-KEANE SET TO RETURN FOR MANCHESTER UNITED.

text.p: Irish international midfielder Roy Keane, who has made only four appearances this season, will return to the Manchester United line-up for their league cup clash with Swindon at Old Trafford on Wednesday.
Manager Alex Ferguson is ready to "freshen up" his side following Sunday's 5-0 premier league defeat by Newcastle at St James' Park.
Keane plays his first game since United's Champions' League victory over Rapid Vienna on September 25 when a knock he picked up on a leg led to internal bleeding.
He played in the first two matches of the season, scoring against Newcastle in the Charity Shield in August and then also played in the first league match against Wimbledon.
Apart from the Vienna match his only other appearance was against Aston Villa on September 21.
Philip Neville, who has not played since the end of August, is also ready to make his comeback after being sidelined following surgery on his ankle.
Ryan Giggs, who missed last week's Champions League match against Fenerbahce and the Newcastle defeat, is still under treatment for a calf strain, but could return.
